informal_statement: The coordinate plane is the product of two real lines.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At CMVGeometry.lean:30-33, the source contract is `abbrev PlanePoint := ℝ × ℝ`. The abbreviation is exactly the Cartesian product of two real lines. Euclidean length is deliberately introduced separately; this declaration alone does not endow the product norm with Euclidean length semantics.
